claims: The National Basketball Association (NBA) consists of 30 teams.
NBA teams are located across the United States and Canada.
Top contenders in the 2025-26 season include the Oklahoma City Thunder, San Antonio Spurs, Denver Nuggets, and Detroit Pistons.
The Eastern Conference Atlantic Division consists of Boston Celtics, Brooklyn Nets, New York Knicks, Philadelphia 76ers, Toronto Raptors.
The Eastern Conference Central Division consists of Chicago Bulls, Cleveland Cavaliers, Detroit Pistons, Indiana Pacers, Milwaukee Bucks.
The Eastern Conference Southeast Division consists of Atlanta Hawks, Charlotte Hornets, Miami Heat, Orlando Magic, Washington Wizards.
The Western Conference Northwest Division consists of Denver Nuggets, Minnesota Timberwolves, Oklahoma City Thunder, Portland Trail Blazers, Utah Jazz.
The Western Conference Pacific Division consists of Golden State Warriors, LA Clippers, Los Angeles Lakers, Phoenix Suns, Sacramento Kings.
The Western Conference Southwest Division consists of Dallas Mavericks, Houston Rockets, Memphis Grizzlies, New Orleans Pelicans, San Antonio Spurs.
As of March 2026, the NBA is considering expansion to 32 teams, with potential new franchises in cities like Seattle or Las Vegas.
